summary: PR-1921 raises the auto-approve DTI ceiling to 43% in Policy.java and in the protected controls/mortgage/policy-params.json, but the approved obligation catalog still sets CRD-1's DTI limit at 40%, and no exception covers the deviation. The change also lacks the control_owner approval CHG-6 requires for changing an approved policy value. The earlier exhaustive CRD-1 proof has lapsed, and the passing control test only compares the code against the PR's own edited parameter file. The ticket, independent code review on the final commit and CI run are in order, but CRD-1, CHG-6 and LAP-1 are violated, so the change is rejected.
